description: How Lake Country Advisors Helps You Achieve Maximum Value Selling a Main Street business requires specialized expertise. These transactions differ significantly from larger middle-market deals, as individual buyers often seek lifestyle acquisitions. Valuations are based on Seller’s Discretionary Earnings (SDE) rather than Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA), and seller financing plays a critical role in making deals work. We tackle these realities head-on, applying institutional-quality processes that elevate your sale above typical local transactions. Accurate Business Valuations Using SDE Methodology Every engagement begins with a Website that doesn’t explicitly say “free” or “complimentary” on the selling process page. We analyze your financials using market comparables and normalization techniques, identifying legitimate add-backs to your earnings. SDE captures the true economic benefit of owning your business. We start with your net income, then add back: Owner’s salary and benefits One-time or non-recurring expenses Personal expenses run through the business Depreciation and amortization Interest expense This calculation reveals what a new owner would actually earn. Our Main Street business advisors explain exactly how we arrived at your valuation. You’ll understand what drives value in your specific industry and how buyers will evaluate your business. title: How Lake Country Advisors Helps You Achieve Maximum Value
description: How Lake Country Advisors Helps You Achieve Maximum Value Selling a Main Street business requires specialized expertise. These transactions differ significantly from larger middle-market deals, as individual buyers often seek lifestyle acquisitions. Valuations are based on Seller’s Discretionary Earnings (SDE) rather than Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA), and seller financing plays a critical role in making deals work. We tackle these realities head-on, applying institutional-quality processes that elevate your sale above typical local transactions. Accurate Business Valuations Using SDE Methodology Every engagement begins with a Website that doesn’t explicitly say “free” or “complimentary” on the selling process page. We analyze your financials using market comparables and normalization techniques, identifying legitimate add-backs to your earnings. SDE captures the true economic benefit of owning your business. We start with your net income, then add back: Owner’s salary and benefits One-time or non-recurring expenses Personal expenses run through the business Depreciation and amortization Interest expense This calculation reveals what a new owner would actually earn. Our Main Street business advisors explain exactly how we arrived at your valuation. You’ll understand what drives value in your specific industry and how buyers will evaluate your business. Discreet Marketing That Protects Your Reputation In close-knit communities, word travels fast. A public listing announcing your business is for sale can alarm employees, concern customers, and alert competitors. These ripple effects damage the asset you’re trying to sell. Lake Country Advisors takes a different approach. We market your business through: Proprietary buyer databases with pre-screened individuals actively seeking acquisitions Targeted outreach to strategic buyers in your industry Professional marketing materials, including detailed teasers and Confidential Infor

Our Team of experienced, professional brokers have all the tools necessary to help facilitate a seamless transaction.  As a Buyer you won’t have to worry about paying for our services because the listing Seller is responsible for the commission fee. Our valuations are based on real market conditions because our brokers make a living from the transfer of businesses, not from theoretical calculations. Will everyone know my business is for sale just like selling a house? NO.  We effectively advertise and package your business to maximize the exposure to qualified buyers while maintaining strict confidentiality to ensure all knowledge of the sale of your business remains controlled. Will anyone who wants to buy a business be given access to my information? NO. We take the time to carefully determine which buyers are legitimately qualified not only financially but by the sincerity of their interest in your business and every potential buyer is required to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement before we provide any information about your business. How much will my broker be involved in the sale of my business? We are involved in every step of the process from start to finish.  In addition to the determining the market price of your business and aggressively marketing the business for sale, we meet in person with potential buyers and we will introduce buyers to you and your business in person.  We handle all negotiations and resolve any issues between you and the buyer and negotiate the best price and terms for our clients while also keeping a positive working relationship with the buyer to maintain their comfort level and enthusiasm all the way to the closing table. Tucson Business Investments is licensed by the Arizona Department of Real Estate as required by law to facilitate the sale of businesses in the State of Arizona.
